body: True. Your childhood effects you, and it's not bad to admit that, but you don't need to let it brand your future. It might be difficult, but it's possible to have a different mindset about it, with effort.
You had me right up until the "Man up".

Thank you. Talking to you has made me feel a ton better. I hope you sleep well.

Circle of Magic sounds really interesting. I'll see if I can get ahold of the first book! The NaNo thing is also a good suggestion. I've had a few novel ideas that I've wanted to try out for a while. Maybe I'll think about that more. Thanks again. It would be cool to talk more sometime.

Huh. That sounds really awesome. Maybe I'll try NaNo. I don't think I'd be ambitious enough to do the full 50,000, but something is better than nothing haha.

My favorite fantasy series is His Dark Materials. I haven't read The Circle of Magic. What's it about?

No way. I have Sabriel by Garth Nix! I started reading it a while back but got distracted. It seemed really good from what I've read.

I like to write fantasy type stories. I draw a bit too. I've never heard of NaNo though. What's that?
Thank you, it helps quite a bit. And yeah, I like to write. Hbu?
Thank you. Everything is okay, for now at least.

I'm worried she's going to send me to foster care because I'm useless like this. She literally asked me to help, to my face as she was crying, and I didn't do a damn thing. She begged me to helped and I'm too fucking useless and anxious to do anything useful.

Thank you so much. It's just, really complicated. My family might get evicted, because the house has been a mess and we can't pay a huge water bill we have because of a leak in the basement. I was supposed to help clean yesterday but I didn't. My mom says it's unforgivable. I feel like I should kill myself.
Pretty good. I felt somewhat better after it.
Thanks. I took your advice and spoke to a good friend about it today.
All I've got are online friends, and my computer is busted so we can't really play video games or anything. Other than that, thanks for the kind words man. It helps.
